manchester_boutique_keeper.text: Alright? Everything in here has lived a life. Some of it has lived two.

then.text: That {worn_coat}? You've got taste. Don't let it near the dryer.
Nice {worn_hat}. Half the Quarter is wearing one, but you're doing it properly.
That {worn_top} is a good start. Let's see what you can put over it.
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: You're in the plain stuff today. Brave, in this city. Have a rummage.

manchester_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
